name: greenside-text-behind
about: Greenside Systems reels, style A (text behind the speaker). Approved on reel 01 v4, 2026-11-13.

style.behind_text: title sits high (top 150 to 450 px) so the head covers only its lower part
style.cta: full-screen green GREENSIDE card covers the CTA; his face is never shown during the CTA
style.audio: every piece levelled to -14 LUFS; CTA takes get highpass 110 Hz and a -2.5 dB low shelf at 220 Hz only; no match EQ, no denoise
style.lists: a count (one, two, three) builds and stays up; it never drops and re-enters
never: reusing one video's chart in another
overlays at the top of the frame
